question: Do the low-rate residual equal-node advantages persist at a deeper common node budget? The32768-node and100ms conditions differ in absolute search work as well as relative throughput, so their score gap cannot be attributed solely to inference cost.
selection: GATE001 and CUBIC001 means at half correction against the identical BRE001 half endpoint, exactly the earlier eight pairs. Fixed131072nodes/move; no changed model, calibration, policy, source or time match.
expectedEvidence: Persistence supports useful residual quality at a more relevant depth with speed still a practical cost. Deterioration at equal nodes indicates depth/search interaction or unstable small-screen rankings; it does not by itself identify a pruning or evaluation defect.
resource: One concurrent game, one worker/engine, no ponder,64MiB TT,768MiB heap,ActiveProcessorCount1,BelowNormal,12games/240seconds per launch;2-second per-move safety limit unchanged. Longer elapsed experiment, no increased parallel CPU or memory.
sequence: After admitted clocks and BRE full/half calibration; before choosing a new substantial training direction. Complete fixed32 games or investigate genuine failures, no favourable-result stopping.
limitations: Reused selected development openings, small sample, repeated testing. This is a depth sensitivity diagnostic, not independent strength confirmation; it does not equate equal-node and practical equal-time strength.
